title: Safety assessment of the 4-(6-phenyl-7h -[1,2,4] triazolo [3,4-b] [1,3,4] thiadiazine-3-yl) -aniline compound and the effects of the substance on respiration and cardiac activity
abstract: 4-(6-phenyl-7H-[1,2,4]-triazolo-[3,4-b] -[1,3,4] -thiadiazine-3-yl) -aniline  compound  belongs  to  the group of triazole derivatives, belongs to class IV low-toxic compounds in acute toxicity, and sodium belongs to the compounds of this group, taking into account the presence of Due to its abilityto block ion channels, it can be concluded that the 1.0 mg/kg dose studied during the experiment led to bradycardia in exchange for a decrease in the activity of the sinus node, which is considered the main regulator of the first-order heart rhythm
